devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapa: jaya jaya he mahiṣāsura-mardini ramya-kapardini śaila-sute ||
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..śiva śiva śumbha niśumbha mahāhava tarpi: śiva śiva śumbha niśumbha mahāhava tarpita bhūta piśāca-rate
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..kṛta kukuthaḥ kukutho gaḍadādikatāla kut: kṛta kukuthaḥ kukutho gaḍadādika-tāla kutūhala gāna-rate |
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..dhudhukuṭa dhukkuṭa dhindhimita dhvani d: dhudhukuṭa dhukkuṭa dhindhimita dhvani dhīra mṛdaṅga nināda-rate
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..jaya jaya japya jaye jaya śabdaparastuti: jaya jaya japya jaye jaya śabda-para-stuti tatpara viśva-nute

devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..ayi sumanaḥ sumanaḥ sumanaḥ sumanaḥ suma: ayi sumanaḥ sumanaḥ sumanaḥ sumanaḥ sumanohara kānti-yute
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..śrita rajanī rajanī rajanī rajanī rajanī: śrita rajanī rajanī rajanī rajanī rajanī-kara vaktra-vṛte |
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..sahita mahāhava mallama tallika mallita: sahita mahāhava mallama tallika mallita rallaka malla-rate
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..alikula saṅkula kuvalaya maṇḍala maulimi: ali-kula saṅkula kuvalaya maṇḍala mauli-milad-bakulāli kule
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..milita pulinda manohara guñjita rañjitaś: milita pulinda manohara guñjita rañjita-śaila nikuñja-gate |
devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..padakamalaṁ karuṇānilaye varivasyati yo': pada-kamalaṁ karuṇā-nilaye varivasyati yo'nudinaṁ sa śive

devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..bhajati sa kiṁ na śacīkucakumbha taṭīpar: bhajati sa kiṁ na śacī-kuca-kumbha taṭī-parirambha sukhānubhavam |

devi/main/01_mahishasuramardini_stotram..tava vimalendukulaṁ vadanendumalaṁ sakal: tava vimalendu-kulaṁ vadanendumalaṁ sakalaṁ nanu kūlayate
